questions.stem: $OABC$ is a parallelogram with $\overrightarrow{OA} = \mathbf{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{OC} = \mathbf{c}$. Express $\overrightarrow{OB}$ in terms of $\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{c}$.
questions.explanation: In parallelogram $OABC$, $B$ is the opposite vertex to $O$. We can reach $B$ by going $O \to A \to B$, i.e. $\overrightarrow{OB} = \overrightarrow{OA} + \overrightarrow{AB} = \mathbf{a} + \mathbf{c}$ (since $\overrightarrow{AB} = \overrightarrow{OC} = \mathbf{c}$).
